instruction: Learning Center Drawing Set This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as result.ifc, result.pdf. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, and result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 7 IfcSpace entities. 5. The IFC model contains at least 2 IfcSlab entities, at least 1 IfcRoof entity, and at least 1 IfcStair entity. 6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: LOBBY, CLASSROOM-1, OFFICE, WC, STAIR, CLASSROOM-2, MAKER. 7. LOBBY, CLASSROOM-1, OFFICE, WC, STAIR are assigned to one storey; and CLASSROOM-2, MAKER are assigned to a second storey. 8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [10.0, 10.0, 6.7]. 9. Result.pdf has exactly 3 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, LEARNING CENTER, CLASSROOM-1, CLASSROOM-2, MAKER, LOBBY, SECTION. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
